name: Shell entity with no operating footprint
description: Entity has no staff, premises, website or trading history consistent with its stated activity, yet receives significant payments.
fp: Start-ups, holding companies and special-purpose vehicles may legitimately lack a footprint.

links.name: Intermediary shell with no operating footprint
links.ctx: Consultant is a recently formed company with no website, staff, or track record yet receives large fees from a firm bidding for government work.
links.fp: Start-ups and sole-trader specialists may have a limited online presence.

links.name: Shell or no-substance entity
links.ctx: Entity has no staff, premises, operations or revenue consistent with its stated activities.
links.fp: Start-ups, SPVs and holding companies lawfully have few operations.

links.name: Shell or newly formed company receiving corporate payments
links.ctx: Mule-side: beneficiary has little trading footprint, a virtual office or recent incorporation.

links.name: Supplier is shell company with no footprint
links.ctx: Registered address and staff do not match the supply.

links.name: Shell entity with no operating footprint
links.ctx: The issuer or promoted company has no real operations, staff or revenue, so its securities have little value beyond the promotional narrative.

links.name: Front company characteristics
links.ctx: Recently formed company with minimal premises or staff, shared address or officers with other trading firms, and large-value technical trades.
links.fp: Start-ups and virtual offices are legitimate.
